subject: Training block consolidation & local-hour windows
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@pilotpay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Training block consolidation & local-hour windows

Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for signing up for the console walkthrough + API enablement. To make the most of the time, we'd like to consolidate two shorter blocks into one focused 2.5-hour session that covers:
- Console walkthrough (45m)
- API keys, auth, and quickstart (35m)
- Hands-on workshop with example integration (60m)
- Q&A and next steps (30m)

Quick asks so we can lock in a slot:
1) Who will attend from PilotPay (names + roles)?
2) Any blackout windows between 9am–6pm in your local HQ timezone?
3) Do you prefer a single 2.5h block or two 1.25h blocks on consecutive days?

I've attached a short prework checklist your engineers can scan beforehand (PilotPay-Prework-Checklist.pdf). Grace and Priyom will run the session — Grace will cover the console and observability, Priyom the API/workshop.

Proposed windows (all US Eastern):
- Wed 9/15 10:00–12:30 ET
- Thu 9/16 14:00–16:30 ET

If those don't work we can present alternate local-hour options for teammates in APAC/EMEA timezones.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on attendees.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PilotPay-Prework-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

Thanks Marcus — this looks good. A couple notes from our side:

Attendees (tentative):
- Sophia Chen (Integration lead)
- Aaron Patel (Backend engineer)
- Leila Martinez (Product manager)
- Enablement alias will loop in our SRE for the hands-on portion

Blackouts: Aaron is on-call that week, so he prefers afternoons; Leila prefers mornings. Our HQ is Eastern, but we have one teammate in London who could join late afternoon ET.

We'd prefer either a single 2.5h block in the afternoon ET or two shorter blocks split morning + late afternoon to accommodate London. If you can propose a split that keeps the hands-on with engineers present (Aaron), that would be best.

I'll coordinate availability on our side and circle back by end of day tomorrow.

—Sophia
Sophia Chen
Integration Lead, PilotPay
sophia.chen@pilotpay.com

Subject: Re: Training block consolidation & local-hour windows

Thanks for the quick reply, Sophia — helpful context. A couple follow-ups from our enablement side: 

Option A (single block, engineer present):
- Wed 9/15 14:00–16:30 ET (afternoon for Aaron, late morning for London)
- We'll keep the workshop exercises scoped to a single integration flow so Aaron can follow along without needing a second machine.

Option B (split blocks):
- Day 1: Wed 9/15 10:00–11:15 ET — console + observability + baseline auth
- Day 2: Thu 9/16 15:00–16:30 ET — hands-on API workshop + Q&A

Operational notes:
- We'll need Aaron on both days for the hands-on; if that's not possible, Option A is safer.
- Grace will prepare the console sample tenant and a short dataset; I'll prepare a Postman collection and a lightweight sample app.

Vivek — can you confirm coverage for the 15:00–16:30 ET window if we go with Option B? That would better cover London attendance.

I'll also add the runbook to the shared drive and attach a trimmed-down markdown copy to the final invite.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Enablement Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

Looping in with coverage confirmation — we can staff both options. My recommendation based on similar customers:

- Go with Option B (split blocks) to maximize attendance across timezones. Make the Day 2 hands-on later (15:00–16:30 ET) so London can join for the workshop.
- Priyom, please mark me as backup for the hands-on; I can lead the workshop Q&A and help with any infra access if Aaron hits on-call duties.

I attached a short runbook we use for console/API dry-runs (console-walkthrough-runbook.md) — it has preflight checks and a quick rollback plan if an integration test modifies tokens or keys.

Marcus — if you want, I can send calendar invites once PilotPay confirms final attendee names and which option they choose.

Thanks,
Vivek
